verdict.rationale: Mem0 provides a documented REST API (confirmed via live OpenAPI spec), SDKs, quickstart guides, and even a workflow for an AI agent to self-provision an account/API key from the terminal and use the API directly, plus a CLI and MCP server for agentic access. This directly satisfies the AI-native, API-driven usage story with strong first-party documentation and a verified OpenAPI endpoint. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer confirmation of the raw API (beyond docs/probes) and more detail on API completeness/versioning.
